quality_issue_investigation_agent.description: Develop an AI-driven investigation assistant tailored for semiconductor manufacturing quality issues, enabling engineers to systematically and methodically dissect anomalies in fabrication processes. This agent synthesizes domain-specific inputs such as defect typology, yield trends, process steps, tool usage, and temporal data, delivering a rigorous, structured investigation roadmap aligned with standard semiconductor fab workflows. It aids in avoiding premature conclusions by emphasizing hypothesis generation, data-driven verification, and logical sequencing of investigative actions, all framed with engineering precision and actionable clarity.
